translated_title: Mexico Refuses to Attend Marco Rubio Summit and Reaffirms Non-Intervention Policy
original_title: México rechaza asistir a cumbre de Marco Rubio y reafirma política de no intervención
author: José Shaddai Olvera Torres
meta_description: The 'far-left political terrorism' meeting was deemed political, not security cooperation; Washington has already been notified of the decision.
